text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first day of summer training camp. 
As for Phalaenopsis—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Trainer. What do you 
think? 
Surely you can tell, can you not?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —I am in excellent form.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, definitely. Let's keep this momentum 
going!

Yeah, you're right. Let's keep this 
momentum going!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis looked as though the haze had 
cleared from her eyes. 
It seemed we would have another productive 
training camp this year.
choice_data_list:
(I will never let what happened last year 
happen again.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Etching only that resolve into my heart, 
I watched carefully as our training 
continued—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Phew... Once it gets to this hour, 
it becomes rather more comfortable—hm?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Is that... Sky?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Phalaeno-chan. 
Hey there, hey there~

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Are they biting around here?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, so-so, I'd say. 
...Oh, wanna join in? Fishing, that is.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I have no tedious errands left 
today. 
I shall keep you company.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Not a single bite. Not in the 
slightest.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Yeah. 
Guess today's just that kind of day.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, how about we take a breather? 
Let's have some barley tea. Barley tea.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *Phaaah*... This is what I live for!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Is this truly the time for rest? 
In times like this, should one not change 
spots, switch bait... 
and commit to trial and error?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sure, there are times when you've gotta do 
that~ 
Still, no need to rush, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
When you get down to it, fishing is kind 
of a battle 
with yourself, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So—stay steady and keep your own pace. 
You'd be surprised how often things work 
out that way.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's how I reeled in 
my very first big catch.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, even then, if the fish on the 
hook 
is too strong, sometimes you just can't 
land it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, though... 
No matter how much you try, there are 
times when you're helpless, 
and opponents you just can't beat~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Against someone like that—you play to your 
strengths. 
You fight on Sei-chan's home turf.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I got my second big one. 
Ah, man... 
Truth is—I really wanted three of 'em, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, something like that? 
That's how I've been fishing all the way 
up to today~

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Sky's words just now... did not sound 
like they were 
merely confined to fishing in the 
slightest.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Almost... as if they evoked 
the days of her past—)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wonder how the next fish will turn out.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...The next fish, you say. How will it 
turn out, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It definitely won't be an easy catch~ 
What should I do... What kind of rig 
should I set up?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, in the end— 
Sei-chan's gonna be the one smiling.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Now, I wonder about that.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It may well prove to be a monster of a 
catch, 
far beyond your ability to handle.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'll be looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the days of summer training 
camp, 
honing themselves for the Sapporo Kinen.
